messages.content: "你能幫我創作一首D小調、每分鐘120拍的音樂，然後產生一個頻率為440赫茲、振幅為0.5的音訊訊號嗎？之後，我想要創作另一首E大調、每分鐘90拍、拍子記號為3/4的音樂。最後，產生另一個頻率為300赫茲、振幅為0.7、持續5秒的音訊訊號。"

function.name: audio_generate
function.description: Generate an audio signal given a frequency, amplitude, and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

frequency.description: Frequency of the audio signal in Hz.

amplitude.description: Amplitude of the audio signal. This is a float type value.

duration.description: Duration of the audio signal in seconds. Default is 1 second if not specified. This is a float type value.

function.name: music_generate
function.description: Generate a piece of music given a key, tempo, and time signature. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

key.description: The key of the piece, e.g., C Major.

tempo.description: Tempo of the piece in beats per minute.

time_signature.description: Time signature of the piece, e.g., 4/4. Default is '4/4' if not specified.

message.reasoning: The user wants to create music pieces and generate audio signals. They want a D minor piece at 120 bpm, then an E major piece at 90 bpm with 3/4 time signature, and then generate an audio signal at 300 Hz, amplitude 0.7, duration 5 seconds. The user also wants a 440 Hz amplitude 0.5 signal. So we need to call the functions twice: one for music_generate for D minor, one for music_generate for E major, and two calls to audio_generate: one for 440 Hz amplitude 0.5 (default duration 1 second), and one for 300 Hz amplitude 0.7 duration 5 seconds. The user didn't specify duration for the 440 Hz signal, so default 1 second. The user didn't specify duration for the 300 Hz signal? Actually they did: 5 seconds. So we need to call audio_generate twice. The user wants to produce the music pieces and audio signals. We can do it in separate calls. The user wants to produce them in order: first D minor, then 440 Hz signal, then E major, then 300 Hz signal. So we need to call the functions in that order. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we can proceed.
